groups.name: hkdfguard
groups.description: The HkdfGuard key ring. The ring is built only when service-name is set.

properties.name: hkdfguard.service-name
properties.description: The service whose KEK protects the ring's keys: 1-128 ASCII letters, digits or '.', e.g. com.example.orders. Setting it turns the key ring on.

properties.name: hkdfguard.key-refresh-interval
properties.description: Seconds (1-300) between re-reveals of each key through the KEK, confirming the KEK is still available. Required.

properties.name: hkdfguard.max-refresh-failures
properties.description: Consecutive failed refreshes tolerated before a key fails closed. At least 1. Unset keeps the builder's default.

properties.name: hkdfguard.fail-open-on-refresh-failure
properties.description: Keep serving on the last good key however many refreshes fail, so revoking the KEK never stops the process. Can't be combined with max-refresh-failures.

properties.name: hkdfguard.ephemeral-key-rotation-hours
properties.description: Hours (1-1193) between ephemeral key rotations. Unset keeps 24 hours. Can't be combined with disable-ephemeral-key-rotation.

properties.name: hkdfguard.disable-ephemeral-key-rotation
properties.description: Turn scheduled rotation off: the startup ephemeral key stays current until restart.

properties.name: hkdfguard.ephemeral-key-retention-hours
properties.description: Hours a superseded ephemeral key stays available for decryption. At least 1. Unset keeps 24 hours.

properties.name: hkdfguard.key-files
properties.description: Versions whose wrapped DEK is read from a file, each with a version and a path.

properties.name: hkdfguard.ephemeral-keys
properties.description: Versions whose key is generated in memory at startup and never persisted.

properties.name: management.health.hkdfguard.enabled
properties.description: Whether to report the key ring's health through Actuator.
